faq.title: Honest
faq.subtitle: If your question isn't here, write us in the form below. We respond within 24 business hours, no sales runaround.

items.q: How much does an engagement with Yesode cost?
items.a: We work with Discovery packages (fixed) and execution contracts (monthly or per delivery). After Discovery — between 1 and 2 weeks — we present a closed estimate with explicit tradeoffs. No hourly billing, no end-of-month surprises.

items.q: What is the average project timeline?
items.a: Critical platforms typically range between 8 and 24 weeks in execution windows. The Run is continuous. You always have a working version in production from week 6, in the worst case.
Yes. Mutual NDA at the very first meeting. Lean model, no abusive clauses — ready for legal review. Everything we hear in Discovery is confidential by default.

items.q: Do you work with our internal team or replace it?
items.a: We reinforce your internal team. We work as a coupled squad: code review, pair programming, ADRs, planning rituals. The contract's goal is to elevate your internal team's level — not create dependency.

items.q: What tech stack do you specialize in?
items.a: TypeScript, Go, Rust, and Python for services. PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, S3 for data. Kubernetes, Terraform, and AWS for infra. Frontend in React/Next. Stack is a Discovery decision — we choose by the problem, not the trend.

items.q: How do you measure a project's success?
items.a: Every engagement starts with a quantified P&L KPI (lead time, conversion, infra cost, technical NPS). We audit that KPI at the end. If it doesn't move, we redo the scope at no charge.

items.q: How does maintenance and evolution work after delivery?
items.a: The "Run" (operations) can be absorbed by your internal team after our progressive handoff, or we can act in a retainer/on-call format for continuous support and evolutionary architecture.

items.q: Do you sell developer hours (Body Shop/Outsourcing)?
items.a: No. We assume technical responsibility for delivering a scope or architectural solution. We don't sell "headcount" to fill gaps in squads — we deliver engineering that solves P&L bottlenecks.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: YESODE CONSULTORIA E SERVIÇOS DE TECNOLOGIA LTDA ("Yesode"), registered under CNPJ/MF No. 53.649.336/0001-38, takes privacy and information security extremely seriously. This Privacy Policy clearly and transparently describes how we process personal data collected through our official website and service channels, in full compliance with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD) — Federal Law No. 13,709/2018.
privacy.s1_p1: Yesode operates exclusively in the B2B (Business-to-Business) model. Our services are designed for mission-critical corporate organizations, and all our communication aims to establish strictly professional relationships. For this reason, all data collected has the strict purpose of commercial qualification of companies and their respective technological demands.
privacy.s1_p2: As a result, we proactively block personal/generic email domains (such as @gmail.com, @hotmail.com, @outlook.com, @yahoo.com, and @icloud.com) in our lead capture form, requiring corporate email addresses.
privacy.s2_title: 2. What data do we collect and why?
privacy.s2_intro: We only collect the strictly necessary information voluntarily submitted by you when requesting a free strategic consultation. The data collected is:
privacy.s2_item_name: Full Name: To identify your contact in a personalized and professional manner.
privacy.s2_item_email: Corporate Email: To enable direct communication between our founding engineers and your company.
privacy.s2_item_company: Company Name: So that we can preliminarily analyze the corporate context, systems architecture, and possible technical needs before the first meeting.
privacy.s2_highlight: DATA SALE PROHIBITION: Yesode does not sell, rent, share, assign, or distribute under any circumstances your registration information to commercial partners or any third parties. Your data is used solely for Yesode's own internal commercial prospecting purposes.
privacy.s3_intro: The processing of personal data by Yesode is supported by the following legal bases established by the LGPD:
privacy.s3_item_1: Contract Execution or Preliminary Procedures (Art. 7, V, LGPD): Necessary to enable the strategic meetings actively requested by you through the form.
privacy.s3_item_2: Legitimate Interest (Art. 7, IX, LGPD): For internal improvement of our commercial intelligence and prevention against fraud and spam.
privacy.s4_p1: The data collected through our form is transmitted using state-of-the-art security protocols (SSL/TLS encryption in transit) and processed through the secure cloud infrastructure of Vercel and the corporate email gateway of Resend.
privacy.s4_p2: We keep your data stored only for the time strictly necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy or until you exercise your right to deletion.
privacy.s5_intro: As a data subject, you can exercise the following rights at any time and at no additional cost:
privacy.s5_item_1: Confirmation and Access: Confirm the existence of processing and access the data we maintain about you.
privacy.s5_item_2: Rectification: Request the correction of incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated data.
privacy.s5_item_3: Deletion (Erasure): Request the complete deletion of your personal data from our database.
privacy.s5_item_4: Consent Revocation: Revoke your permission for future commercial communications.
privacy.s6_p1: To ensure a premium browsing experience and optimize our site's infrastructure, we use static traffic analysis tools (such as Vercel Analytics and Vercel Speed Insights).
privacy.s6_p2: These tools collect completely anonymized data (such as network latency, browser used, and page load times). No personal data capable of identifying the user is stored or analyzed by these technical telemetry services.
privacy.s7_p1: We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect regulatory, jurisprudential changes, or technological advances in our architecture. The date of the last update will always be visible at the top of this document.
privacy.contact_text: If you wish to exercise any of your rights established by the LGPD or clarify doubts about our data protection architecture, contact our DPO (Data Protection Officer) directly:
